description: Four helpers in one panel: two scaler and offsetters, two octave folders and two analogue shift registers

params.text: A voltage added after the scaling, -10V to +10V
The bottom of the range the voltage is folded into, 0 to 9
The top of the range the voltage is folded into, 1 to 10

inputs.text: The voltage to be scaled and offset
A voltage moving the scaling of that section
A voltage moving the offset of that section
The voltage the shift register takes in
A pulse moves every value along one place, the input taking the first place

outputs.text: The input voltage multiplied by the scale setting with the offset added
The input voltage shifted by whole volts until it falls between the min and max settings
One of the four places of the shift register; the value was at the input four pulses ago if this is the last place

notes: with nothing patched to the input of the second shift register, the two shift registers join into one eight step register.
with nothing patched to the clock input of the second shift register, it is clocked by the pulse arriving at the first one's clock input.
in a folder section, a maximum set at or below the minimum is treated as the minimum plus 1.
every section works on polyphonic cables.
